site.title: {brand} — real-time monitoring made simple
site.description: {brand} is a real-time monitoring information system: offline mobile data collection, a multi-level hierarchy, dashboards and AI-assisted visualisation — free forever.

hero.title: Welcome to {brand}.
hero.lead: The powerful platform that manages your data with ease — and uses AI to turn it into visualisations, automatically. Curious? Come try it yourself.

demo.caption: Illustrative data — pick a sector to see the workspace respond.

freeBand.title: Free forever. Every core feature, no catch.
freeBand.body: Forms, offline mobile collection, dashboards and AI visualisation — all free, for good. Need advanced capabilities or a custom build? There is a paid option for that.

howItWorks.heading: A workspace of your own, in three steps.
howItWorks.subtitle: Self-service setup that feels like a conversation, not a form.

steps.title: Answer a few questions
steps.body: Tell us what you want to monitor — one question at a time.

steps.title: We build your workspace
steps.body: Your forms, your places hierarchy and your dashboards are set up automatically from your answers.

steps.title: Collect and visualise
steps.body: Gather data on web and offline mobile, then let AI turn it into dashboards and maps.

why.heading: The practical middle ground.
why.subtitle: More structure than a survey tool, far less weight than a full health information system.

cards.title: Offline mobile
cards.body: A native app with local storage and background sync for the field.

cards.title: Hierarchy and monitoring
cards.body: Multi-level places and first-class monitoring forms for repeat visits.

cards.title: AI dashboards
cards.body: A dashboard builder with charts, maps and AI-suggested visualisations.

cards.title: Free to start
cards.body: Every core feature, no tiers. Partner with us when you want to go further.

benchmark.heading: Kobo, {brand}, DHIS2 — where we sit.
benchmark.subtitle: An honest look. {brand} is deliberately in the middle of the complexity spectrum.
benchmark.caption: The middle path — more structure and monitoring than a survey tool, far less operational weight than a full HIS. Draft — pending review.

partner.title: Ready to go further?
partner.body: The core platform is free forever. For advanced capabilities, custom solutions and long-term support, we partner with you.

finalCta.title: Your data, working for you — today.
finalCta.body: Spin up a workspace in a couple of minutes. Free forever.
